horoscopes.horoscope: You will be very active today. Your activities will result in progress and success. However in the evening you will feel the need for some solitude. Pay heed to your moods, and get into a solitary corner to be alone. Ganesha says it’s okay to confide your problems to your dog. When you call it a day, spending a great evening with your beloved will be the only thing on your mind, foresees Ganesha. It seems that you can do anything for the one you love. You may decide to make the night really enjoyable and bright. You may need to work harder to achieve something today. There will be scope of getting into conflicts and arguments, which might impact your health adversely. You should try to remain very practical while dealing with people and situations, says Ganesha. If you have applied for loan, it may get sanctioned. During the second half of the day you will realise that the value of money increases only if it is used at the right time and place. Once you will put your hard work today, it will surely give you handsome rewards at the end of the day, says Ganesha. With important meetings and conferences on the agenda, you may not have a minute to spend time with your colleagues.

This day you will be thinking of pleasant outings, picnics and pleasure trips. The morning could be spent with your friends and family members, finalising plans and programmmes. But, warns Ganesha, you could lose track of things later in the day and, unfortunately, change your plans and end up by spoiling a lovely, enjoyable day and turning it into a drab and dull affair. You could at the end become extremely bored and listless. Lucky Colour Light Emerald Green You are likely to spend the evening watching an entertainment show with your sweetheart. You may buy popcorn and play the love games while the show is on. You may adopt some scintillating acts to satisfy the mood of your partner, feels Ganesha. While the day will be good overall, your routine will be more hectic during the second half of the day. It is a good time to start a trip in the second half of the day. Health and mood both will remain good today, feels Ganesha. This is the best time to think more practically about money matters. You like stability and security when it comes to money and family. Today you are going to increase your sense of financial stability. The day starts with some easy tasks. However, as the day moves ahead, your workload will be heavier. Client communication via emails on crucial matters will make your eyes glued to your monitor, says Ganesha. You will be pleased to make a deal today.

You will attempt to be a part of your elders’ or your friend’s sorrows and try to lighten their burdens. Your kind and courteous nature, as well as your joviality will cheer them up. The later half of the day will be filled with entertainment and happiness. A romantic date in the evening is possible, says Ganesha. Express your sweetheart frankly whenever your works get finished. Today is the time to keep calm especially when you are with your lover. Silence keeps both of you engaged. You are eventually likely to find peace and solemnity. Romantic life will be full of joy. Today, you will be playing the role of problem shooter and that is going to take up lot of energy. You might need to keep switching your mind to various activities. This is most likely to upset you a bit too. Ganesha feels you are going to remain objective and open to financial matters. Whatever needs to be spent, must be spent but within the budget – this is what you are going to think. Your day will start with solving technical issues or clearing jammed communication lines. You will be able to identify all the issues in the meeting clearly and crack the problems swiftly. Later, you might be busy in designing a software. The important project is likely to get achieved by the evening.

The day proceeds lazily. But your work will pick up pace later in the day. Ganesha cautions about your health. As chance of stomach upset is likely, be careful of what you eat or drink. Do not neglect any ailment and contact doctor promptly. You need to remain extra careful in handling your personal relationship as disagreements are on the cards with loved one. You are likely to get hot-tempered. The flared up tempers can act as a spoilsport in the love game. The long-term relationship should be your priority now. Avoid pondering about anything today. Also don’t worry and don’t hurry. Just be at ease, advises Ganesha. Overstraining your body and over-stressing your mind may adversely affect your health. Frankly express your innermost feelings to loved ones – it will delight you. Ganesha feels that today you are unlikely to spend lavishly on anything, and yet you shall be able to purchase the things you desire, as you are likely to get good deals on them. The only thing that you might not be able to catch up with is concentration. Ganesha advises you to be very particular about everything that you do. You need to check your mood. You might attend events which will enhance your performance at work.

There is no other way out of your current predicament except hard work. You will need to decide whether you want to work hard to achieve your goals, or let them slip by in pursuit of leisure. It is in your best interests to make some effort now to reap substantial gains later, says Ganesha. Love life will be good provided that you don’t tend to dominate your sweetheart. You may be in a mood to get engaged in creative works but later you are likely to amuse your loved one through your amazing voice. A committed relationship is on the cards, says Ganesha. After spending lots of time for reviewing your activities in various spheres of life, you will realise that you should strike the right balance between work and play. This shall enable you to live a more comfortable life, advises Ganesha. Today you may be assailed by the feeling that you made a mistake by not investing rightly a few years ago, but Ganesha assures you that it is not too late and you can start saving even now. Attending seminars might increase your know-how. However, you need to fulfill your primary responsibilities at work, suggests Ganesha. Casual conversations might also take place. Thinking about the work you have done today, you might not be ready to talk about anything else with anyone at your home.

Today it will be family responsibilities that will dominate the day. Juniors will offer you a lot of help, but you must remember that what you seek is valuable and that it will demand a lot of effort from you. Ganesha advises you to be careful of people in general. You love to meet your beloved at the end of the day but the pending tasks will keep you occupied with responsibilities and may not let your love life stay happy. You may have to keep in touch with your sweetheart via phone call, SMS, e-mail or social media message. After running from pillar to post during first half of today, obviously you are going to feel weary. You should therefore avoid over-stretching your muscles and overtaxing your brain after lunch time to maintain your fitness level, advises Ganesha. Today you are likely to gain some money through your hobbies. In short, Ganesha says the time is right to commercialise your talents. You may be serious about your career, but realise that other things matter too. You would criticise yourself if you are thinking that you will not get any ideas today. Have a paper and pen with you to jot them down. When you are half way through the day, you will think about arming yourself with more skills at the professional front, says Ganesha.

Ganesha says you will think twice before spending today. You shall try to save your money by bargaining too. The afternoon is an auspicious time to propose to your loved one for marriage. Today is the day you shall experience love and closeness with your partner. Ganeshji sends you his best wishes. The relationship with your sweetheart might face a serious contemplation. This will certainly bring more meaning to you and your partner being together. You are likely to discuss some issues with your loved one and bring some important changes. You are determined to bring harmony in your relationship. Ganesha foresees a hectic and humdrum day, particularly till lunch time. You will spend time for interacting with your coworkers or associates to maintain a good and long-lasting relationship. In the evening you should enjoy life with your friends or relatives. Ganesha cautions you against both taking or extending loans, as the day is not auspicious for the activity. What you need is the self-confidence to depend on your own financial resources. The long-term plans will catch your attention today, foresees Ganesha. At work, decision-making will be comfortable today as you will use your head more than your heart. Sound judgement will clear many confusions and will create a path for a smooth progress, says Ganesha.

Flaunt your sunny side up as the day begins on a cheerful note. Ganesha says, you will enjoy cordial relations with people around you. Overall, the day seems to be good. You spend quality time with your beloved. Passion and love may rejuvenate your love life. Serious discussions with your life partner are on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Therefore, you need to keep a check on your temper. Stay cool and you will know more things about your partner than you did yesterday. Managing emotional stability will be the challenge of the day, says Ganesha. Ganesha says that you may come across some odd people who may try to tarnish your image. To handle this tricky situation you must simply remain composed. Then, instead of getting annoyed, just get friendly and resolve the differences. On the financial front today, Ganesha says that is is going to be a mixed bag of fortune. While you shall be satisfied with the inflow of funds, you shall be burdened with heavy outflow of money, too. Today’s planetary alignment will concentrate your interests in long-term plans. When it comes to work, contrary to your emotional nature, you will think practically. Results are likely to get delayed but you will stick to your plans to fetch better outcomes. You want to be a perfectionist today.

It’s raining money, literally as your bank accounts swell. When it comes to financial security, now, you are a happy man. However, Ganesha advises you to stay away from pessimistic people who may adversely affect your future. Romance is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. So, stay amazed. You will get emotional support from your beloved. You are likely to please your sweetheart by engaging in different activities. Ganesha says you should remain busy in that activity that is always loved by your partner. With lots of things to do, you may lose direction and get tired by lunch time. Rather than postponing your work for tomorrow, make all efforts to finish them today. As the day ends, relax with your family, says Ganesha. You shall have the good fortune of a friend helping you to clinch a good project which will be very lucrative. Ganesha advises you to lay a strong foundation and then build quickly upon it. Luck is on your side. Therefore, things should go quite well for you today. You are determined to perform exceptionally well. With your colleagues and boss’ working hand in hand with you, you will surely be able to finish your tasks well before time.

Most of us have an idol from whom derive motivation and inspiration. Today, you will find your idol and get inspired to perform better. During the later part of the day, you get into a war of words with somebody. Avoid this, otherwise you may have to face some legal consequences, warns Ganesha. Also, it can hurt your career prospects. You feel you want hugs and kisses which will electrify your love. Whenever you will spend a good time with your sweetheart, you will be able to connect better and communicate better. Ganesha feels that a long-term relationship is on the cards. Ganesha feels that today, you will be feeling mental pressure of work. You should address everything pending – as soon as possible. Do not keep anything for tomorrow. During second half of the day, you are likely to remain busier and very stressed. Ganesha feels that you should try to bank upon your contacts abroad. If you are willing to shift abroad or if you wish to work there for a few years to earn good money, today is the day to apply. With the heap of files on your desk getting accumulated, you will review the amount of pending work. You will exemplify yourself with the abundant energy you have got today. However, you need to act tactfully while dealing with others, suggests Ganesha.

Your creativity will come to the fore today. Music will give a let out to your emotions and creativity, says Ganesha. You will aim for the bull’s eye today and to everyone’s surprise, you’ll hit it, too. The day is expected to go well; however, some unforeseen events in the evenings may spoil your mood and create some confusion. You need to keep motivating your sweetheart if he or she is down with no hope. Eventually, your partner will feel safe in your arms. The delights of love and romance will fill your heart this evening and Ganesha says that it will be long lasting. Ganesha feels that you will be wasting your energy behind arguments, discussions and conflicts today. You will be giving emphasis on wrong things. There may be moments, when you will have to control your anger and outbursts. This is important today. The day doesn’t look good for financial matters. You will be worried about ancestral property. If legal case related to the same is going on, it might get stretched further. You may be disappointed with your business partner. You will have a strong urge to take break. Under the transformational power of today’s astral configuration, you may change your job or working style. You need to avoid getting into the disagreement and charge into situations where you may be putting yourself at risk.

Other people will have high expectations from you. You will be required to co-operate with others and give your co-workers more of your time than is their due. However, your co-workers will also reciprocate in equal measure when the need arises. You will be determined to complete all your projects on time. Your thinking will be progressive today, and hence your day will be productive, says Ganesha. Fantasy reigns your mind tonight and you may like to take part in different love games with your sweetheart. You are likely to get teased by your beloved. It is expected to rejuvenate your energy. A wonderful evening will keep you stress-free, foresees Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today you will be working very hard. But this would to complete old remaining works. You may not be working to achieve targets but you will be working to finish off pending tasks. You are likely to be less emotional and more practical. Ganesha feels that today you will be confused about money matters. Income and expenses both are going to keep you confused. You will not know how to earn or save more money. Hard work is the key to success, they say, but it will pay you less today. Your day may turn worse as you will be dumped with loads of responsibilities, cautions Ganesha. Planning and organizing should be your weapons that will boost your work.
